hook_text: You will not find a fisher in the Karoo or a sheep shearer in the middle of Johannesburg. Why not?
clip_script: Career day in Polokwane. A farmer grows tomatoes. A nurse works at the clinic. A taxi driver carries people to work. A miner digs for platinum. A factory worker packs juice. Jobs depend on the place. Farms need farmers. Villages need teachers and shopkeepers. Towns and cities have the most kinds of jobs, because they have the most people and the most buildings. The place shapes the work, and the work shapes the place.
visual_style: Whiteboard career day: parents stand in a row, each with a hat or tool, and arrows link each job to a farm, village, town or city drawing.
mood: Cheerful and busy, like a school career day.
pacing: One parent at a time, a quick reason why their job fits their place, then the big pattern.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and ask an adult at home where they work and why.
